For the best French croissant dough, you need European high-fat butter and active dry yeast.
Laminating the croissant dough requires three letter folds with refrigeration between each fold.
Bake the croissants at 200 degrees Celsius until golden brown and flaky on the crust.
Sourdough bread requires feeding your starter daily with equal parts unbleached flour and filtered water.
Perform stretch and folds every thirty minutes during bulk fermentation to build gluten structure.
Preheat your cast iron Dutch oven for forty-five minutes before baking the sourdough loaf.
Score the top of the bread dough with a sharp razor blade to create a beautiful ear.
Bake covered with the Dutch oven lid on for twenty minutes to trap steam, then uncover for color.
Allow the loaf to cool completely on a wire rack before slicing to avoid gummy crumb texture.
Chocolate babka dough is enriched with eggs and layered with melted dark chocolate and cinnamon.
